atrium.name: atrium
atrium.description:
The atrium is where everyone arrives, and it has the worn look of a place
that knows it. A wide floor of pale stone, a ceiling too high to make out,
and doorways on every side standing open. Somebody has left a coat over the
back of a chair nobody is sitting in.

Voices carry here. They do not carry out.

backroom.name: backroom
backroom.description:
A small room behind the front of the house: a kettle, a table, three
mismatched chairs and a corkboard nobody has tidied since spring. This is
where the people who keep the place running come to stop keeping it running
for ten minutes.

cabin.name: cabin
cabin.description:
One room, one window, one chimney doing its best. Firewood stacked with
care along the whole of the south wall, and a bolt on the inside of the
door.

concourse.name: concourse
concourse.description:
A long curved corridor with a door to everywhere, each one labelled in a
small neat hand. It is not a room anybody stays in. It is the room you pass
through on the way to the one you meant.

copse.name: copse
copse.description:
A stand of young trees, thin and close and all the same age, as though
they had all agreed to start together. The light comes through in bars and
the ground is bare.

den.name: den
den.description:
A hollow under a bank, roofed with roots and floored with dry leaf.
Something lives here. It is out. It has clearly been out for some time,
which is the only reason you are still standing in the doorway.

gallery.name: gallery
gallery.description:
A long room hung with pictures of rooms. Some of them you recognise. One
of them is this one, painted from where you are standing, which is either a
compliment or a warning.

glade.name: glade
glade.description:
A clearing in the trees where the light comes down in one soft column.
The grass is flattened in a ring, as if something large had slept here and
then thought better of mentioning it.

grotto.name: grotto
grotto.description:
A low cave at the waterline, floored with wet shingle and lit green from
below. The tide has left things here in rows, sorted by size, as if
something patient had been doing the sorting.

hall.name: hall
hall.description:
A high panelled hall with a long table down the middle and a gallery
above. It is set up for something formal, and has been for years. Nobody
remembers what.

holding_cell.name: holding cell
holding_cell.description:
Four walls, a bench, and a window set too high to see anything through but
weather. The door is on the other side of the wall from you.

Somebody will come. They usually do.

lawn.name: lawn
lawn.description:
A flat green lawn, mown in stripes by somebody with strong opinions about
stripes. Hoops are set out for a game whose rules were last written down a
long time ago and have been improved since.

lodge.name: lodge
lodge.description:
A small house of one room and a great many hooks. Boots by the door,
kettle on, a chair drawn up close to the stove. Everything in it is the
right size for somebody slightly smaller than you.

mirror_hall.name: mirror hall
mirror_hall.description:
A hall of facing mirrors.
                 Every wall repeats every wall.
              Step forward and a hundred of you agree.
                 Step back and they agree again.

              The writing on the far wall is reversed,
                and reads better if you don't try.

oak.name: oak
oak.description:
One enormous tree standing on its own, with a bench round the trunk and
initials cut into the bark going back further than the bench does. The
canopy is its own weather.

orchard.name: orchard
orchard.description:
Old trees in rows that have stopped being rows, standing in long grass.
Windfalls underfoot. Whatever was planted here was planted by somebody who
did not expect to eat from it.

overlook.name: overlook
overlook.description:
A shelf of rock with the whole valley laid out below it and nothing at all
between you and the drop. A good place to sit and be quiet at.

parlour.name: parlour
parlour.description:
A long table under an awning, laid for far more people than are ever here
at once, and never cleared. The teapot is warm. Nobody admits to having
made it.

plaza.name: plaza
plaza.description:
A wide paved square laid out in black and white, big enough that crossing
it feels like a decision. Benches at the edges. In the middle, nothing at
all, which is the point of a plaza.

rampart.name: rampart
rampart.description:
A broad stone wall wide enough to walk two abreast along the top of, with
a parapet on the outward side and a long drop on the other. It defends
nothing any more and does it very well.

refectory.name: refectory
refectory.description:
Trestle tables, benches, and the particular echo of a room built for
eating in. It smells faintly and permanently of bread.

rotunda.name: rotunda
rotunda.description:
A round room with no corners to argue in, which has not stopped anybody.
The floor is a circle worn smooth by people walking round it while
disagreeing, and the acoustics are unforgiving.

shore.name: shore
shore.description:
A long grey beach of small flat stones that shift and click underfoot.
The water arrives without much conviction and leaves again. Somebody has
built a cairn and somebody else has knocked most of it over.

spring.name: spring
spring.description:
Water comes up out of the rock here, cold enough to hurt, and goes away
downhill in a hurry. There is a stone lip worn into a seat by people who
came to fill something and stayed.

stall.name: stall
stall.description:
A shopfront barely wider than its door, with shelves to the ceiling and
one of everything on them. The proprietor is elsewhere. A hand-lettered
card says BACK SHORTLY and has faded almost white.

thicket.name: thicket
thicket.description:
Close-grown scrub, thorn and bramble, with a path through it that is more
of a rumour. Things move alongside you at about knee height and decline to
be seen.
